note: 规则覆盖外的问法：IN / 多值筛选、季度、HAVING、Top-N 不是固定 10、窗口占比、复购、按状态分布、滚动 7 天。expected_sql 手写并按业务口径可执行，不复制生成器输出；这组不并入基础 50 条。

cases.question: 销量最好的三个商品
cases.note: Top-3 不是规则的固定 LIMIT 10/20；规则不认「最…的三个」
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: 华东和华南的GMV对比
cases.note: 多值筛选：规则把两个地区拼成 AND，恒为空集
cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND r.region_name IN ('华东', '华南') GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.question: 按季度看GMV
cases.note: 季度不是规则的时间维度；要自己从 order_date 推季度
cases.expected_sql: SELECT substr(o.order_date, 1, 4) || '-Q' || ((CAST(substr(o.order_date, 6, 2) AS INTEGER) + 2) / 3), ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY 1

cases.question: 退款率最高的品类
cases.note: Top-1 不是规则的「分组 + LIMIT 10」；退款率口径本身就按全状态算
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 4) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: 客单价超过7000的品牌
cases.note: HAVING + 阈值筛选；规则只会分组，没有聚合后过滤
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.brand, ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY p.brand HAVING ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) > 7000

cases.question: 上季度GMV
cases.note: 自然季度不是规则的时间词；要按当前月份推导上一个日历季度
cases.expected_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= date('now','start of month','-' || (((CAST(strftime('%m','now') AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) + 3) || ' months') AND o.order_date < date('now','start of month','-' || ((CAST(strftime('%m','now') AS INTEGER) - 1) % 3) || ' months')

cases.question: 各订单状态的订单数
cases.note: 状态分布要按状态分组且不筛 paid；规则给所有指标都焊了 status='paid'
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.status, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o GROUP BY o.status

cases.question: 最近7天每天的订单数
cases.note: 滚动 7 天不是规则的 6 类时间；还要按天分组
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.order_date, ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= date('now','-7 day') GROUP BY o.order_date

cases.question: 各地区销量占全国比例
cases.note: 占比要窗口/子查询算全国总量；规则只会给绝对销量
cases.expected_sql: SELECT r.region_name, ROUND(SUM(i.quantity) * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(i2.quantity) FROM order_items i2 JOIN orders o2 ON o2.order_id = i2.order_id WHERE o2.status = 'paid'), 4) FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY r.region_name

cases.question: 复购客户数
cases.note: 复购要先按客户聚合再 HAVING 计数；规则只会数去重客户
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o WHERE o.status = 'paid' GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2)
